title: ACOTAR 6 Midnight Release Party
long_description:
✨🌙 Midnight in Velaris is calling🌙✨

Join us this October 26th for our Midnight Release Party celebrating Book 6 of the ACOTAR series! We are parterning with the TBR Bookbus and Sincerely Yours Bookstore for the night!🖤📚

Step into a night inspired by Velaris filled with:

•WeaponUp Sword Yoga

•Vendor Market

•Magical crafts

•Fun activities & games

•Costume contest (dress as your favorite character!)

✨ Surprises worthy of the Night Court

Grab your friends, channel your inner High Fae, and get ready for a night that feels straight out of Velaris.

🗡️ ACOTAR Release Party Ticket Holders Exclusive Session

8:30–9:30 PM

🎟️ Add the session to your existing ticket:
